title: Occupancy and Residency Certification Servicing Manual — Acceptance of Certifications and Completion of a Cycle
content:
**§1 Acceptance.** Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, an occupancy certification submission is accepted only when all four of the following hold; where one fails, it is rejected with the reason paired with it:

| Condition | Reason recorded when it fails |
|---|---|
| the signer holds one of the plan's required certifier roles | signer not required |
| the channel is permitted for the plan (phone, servicing portal or mail, as the plan's channel settings provide) | channel not accepted |
| the plan's supporting document is on file and not older than the plan's renewal period for it | supporting document missing |
| it is signed no earlier than the plan's early-certification period in calendar days before the cycle's due date | outside certification window |

**§2 Recording.** A certification is recorded only from an occupancy certification submission on file whose review status is accepted; the submission on file, identified by its reference, is the authority, not the caller's account of it.

**§3 Signer entries — no longer in force.** The clause under which each signer was recorded once per cycle, with the signature date as the date of the entry and the cycle's certification year, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for recording signer entries.

**§4 Completion.** A cycle is complete when the number of distinct signers recorded on the profile under the open cycle — the entries whose certification year equals the calendar year of the profile's due date — reaches the plan's required signature count. A signer missing from a partial certification may sign within the plan's cure period in calendar days without a new request.

**§5 Effect of completion — dates no longer in force.** The clause under which, when a cycle completed, the last certified date became the date of the last required signature and the due date moved forward by the plan's certification interval to the next closing anniversary is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. Still in force: a profile that was pending first certification or overdue becomes current when its cycle completes.

**§6 Statements of non-occupancy.** A certification never counts if it states that no borrower lives in the home; such a statement is handled as non-occupancy.

**§7 Household conditions.** A Non-Borrowing Spouse Household or Deferral Period certification also attests that the non-borrowing spouse remained married to the borrower, per the plan's marriage-attestation setting, and the profile stays current only while that spouse occupies the home, per the plan's spouse-occupancy setting. A Living Trust certification needs a borrower-beneficiary in occupancy, per the plan's trust-beneficiary setting. No plan allows a seasonal or second home to count as the principal residence, and on a two-to-four-unit property a borrower must occupy one unit.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- *Count reached.* A Joint Borrower Certification profile requires 2 distinct signers. With one living borrower recorded under the open cycle the cycle is incomplete; when the second living borrower is recorded under the same certification year, the count reaches 2 and the cycle is complete. A second entry by the first borrower would not raise the count, because signers are counted distinct.
- *Early signature.* On a plan whose early-certification period is 60 calendar days, a form signed 61 days before the due date is rejected as outside certification window; one signed exactly 60 days before is not too early.
- *Status on completion.* An overdue profile whose cycle completes becomes current; so does a profile pending its first certification.

superseded_clauses: Each signer is recorded once per cycle, with the signature date as effective_date and the cycle's certification_year.

When a cycle completes, last_certified_date becomes the date of the last required signature and certification_due_date moves forward certification_frequency_months months to the next closing anniversary;
